notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B helpdesk) evaluating Redwood Hosted API with eye toward Dedicated eventually. Primary use is in-app support chat agents for enterprise customers. Streaming required (real-time agent experience). Firm asks: <1.5s first-token 95p, tool calling to internal CRM + knowledge-base, SSO for admin UI, SOC2 evidence, and the option to move to Dedicated for isolation and predictable throughput.

From kickoff call: customer excited about Redwood streaming demo; liked function/tool call pattern for structured actions (e.g., create ticket, surface KB article). Concern: current 95p latency at 1.8s — SE suggested kernel and batching tweaks + regional edge routing.

Quoted from CTO: "We need human-like responsiveness in the widget — anything >1.5s feels sluggish for our enterprise users."

POC details: team plugged sandbox keys into web widget on staging. Traffic sim: 120 concurrent users peak during test window, average session length ~15 messages. SE recommended prefix caching for long-running tickets and route low-cost requests to smaller models, fallback to larger when hallucination risk is high.

Security: Provided SOC2-type artifacts to Lodestar security team; waiting on signed AUP and confirmation of KMS support for Dedicated during procurement.

Commercial: Interested in usage-based for Hosted initially; will evaluate reserved capacity pricing for Dedicated if POC meets SLOs. Estimated ARR range submitted. Pricing follow-up planned week of 2026-03-16.
